method: Single sequential measurement per scenario, no hard performance threshold. Host concurrency is not controlled; concurrent browser acceptance runs were active during this measurement. 160 mm paper, 8 layers; 100 small edge notches share the existing 50-cut fixture depth and occupy the same edge at twice the density. Separated scenario replaces the final notch with a full-width folded strip.
renderBoundary: svgPathMs measures exact unfolded SVG path serialization, not browser DOM/layout/paint or Worker startup.
baselineComparison: NOT_TESTED: no historical runtime baseline was re-created; these are current V3 measurements only.
